scope: Primary-source review for the unchanged dependency versions and logcat API guards
findings: API21/22/23 use short logcat options; API24 introduces the long PID and clear options. Use -c throughout and --pid only from API24.
API21 threadtime places numeric PID/TID before arbitrary tag and payload. Filter the PID column and frame on LF; bare CR remains payload.

The pinned coroutines1.10.2 IO limitedParallelism view is independent of the normal IO parallelism limit, but still shares the underlying scheduler. Synchronous platform destroy/close calls have no universal deadline.
